"''Copy that, Juggernaut Five. Juggernaut Four has reached the north exit. You're all clear.|The pilot and refinery control|}} A [[Human]] [[Gender|male]] '''Juggernaut pilot''' served in a [[Morak Imperial remnants|remnant]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] on the [[planet]] [[Morak]] in [[9 ABY]]. Driving the [[HCVw A9.2 juggernaut transport]] [[Juggernaut Five]] with another [[Juggernaut Pilot|Juggernaut pilot]]. As the [[transport]] entered [[T-12 (tunnel)|tunnel T-12]], the [[pilot]]s were attacked by the infiltrator [[Carasynthia Dune|Cara Dune]], who incapacitated both. The infiltrators [[Migs Mayfeld]] and [[Din Djarin]] then wore the Juggernaut pilot and his comrade's respective [[armor]] to [[Mission to Morak|infiltrate]] the remnant's [[rhydonium]] [[Morak Imperial refinery|refinery]]. ==Biography== {{Quote|Oh, my god, this guy reeked.|Migs Mayfeld after putting on the pilot's armor|}} During the [[New Republic Era|reign]] of the [[New Republic]], the [[Juggernaut Pilot|Juggernaut pilot]] served in a [[Morak Imperial remnants|remnant]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] which operated at a [[rhydonium]] [[Morak Imperial refinery|refinery]] on the [[jungle]] [[planet]] [[Morak]]. One [[Standard day|day]], in [[9 ABY]],{{MandoDate|15|the [[Juggernaut Pilot|Juggernaut pilot's]] appearance}} he and another [[pilot]] drove one of the refinery's [[HCVw A9.2 juggernaut transport]]s, designated [[Juggernaut Five]], [[transport]]ing rhydonium to the refinery. As the transport approached [[T-12 (tunnel)|tunnel T-12]], the Juggernaut pilot reported the approach to the refinery over comms, and the [[Unidentified Imperial controller (Morak)|controller]] replied that Juggernaut Five was clear to continue. As Juggernaut Five entered the tunnel, the infiltrators [[Din Djarin]], [[Carasynthia Dune|Cara Dune]] and [[Migs Mayfeld]] jumped on top of the transport. Dune climbed through the cockpit hatch and landed behind the two pilots, the juggernaut pilot and his comrade turning round upon hearing her land. The pilot then raised his [[SE-14r light repeating blaster]], attempting to make a statement, but Dune disarmed him and dealt blows to both pilots before knocking their heads on the dashboard, incapacitating the pair. With the pilots defeated, Mayfeld [[Clothing|wore]] the juggernaut pilot's [[armor]] while Djarin wore his comrade's armor. Djarin and Mayfeld then [[Mission to Morak|infiltrated]] the refinery, before escaping with information from a terminal. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|What the…|The pilot raises his blaster at Cara Dune|}} A male individual, the Juggernaut pilot raised his [[blaster]] upon noticing Cara Dune, but was ultimately bested by the infiltrator. ==Equipment== {{Quote|His gloves are still wet.|Migs Mayfeld|}} The Juggernaut pilot wore [[Color|grey]] armor and clothing, which Migs Mayfeld claimed to smell bad, adding that the pilot's [[glove]]s were wet. The pilot also wielded a SE-14r light [[repeating blaster]] and drove the Imperial Combat Assault Transport Juggernaut Five. ==Behind the scenes== The Juggernaut pilot first appeared in "[[Chapter 15: The Believer]]" of [[Jon Favreau]]'s [[2019]] [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', directed by [[Rick Famuyiwa]] and released on [[December 11]], [[2020]].{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-december-2020|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in December 2020}} Credited as "Pilot 1" in the subtitles and named "Juggernaut Pilot" in the credits, he was played by [[Miguel A. Lopez]]. ==Appearances== *[[The Mandalorian Season 2 Junior Novel|''The Mandalorian Season 2'' Junior Novel]] *{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 15: The Believer}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Piloto de Juggernaut Imperial no identificado |ka=ჯაგერნაუტის უცნობი იმპერიელი პილოტი }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Imperial Army pilots]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Members of the Morak Imperial remnants]]
